infrastructure.database: PostgreSQL 16 in a disposable local Docker container
infrastructure.database_targets: Random detectra_test_<uuid> databases only; all removed after the runs
infrastructure.application_browser_test: Real Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, local storage and yolov8s-oiv7 inference; no API or inference mocks
infrastructure.browser_regression_test: Simulated API responses in desktop Chromium, mobile Chromium and desktop WebKit
infrastructure.camera_fixture: A temporary MJPEG AVI created from the attributed astronaut image and read by OpenCV

physical_camera.probe: TCP connection only; no authentication, capture or database writes

fixes_verified: Dictionary-row connection typing and runtime CRUD schema registration
Pool and camera cleanup when application startup, requests or shutdown fail
RTSP query/fragment credential redaction and IPv6 address preservation
Camera capture exceptions release the capture and retry without publishing the exception URL
limitations: The fixture checks workflow behavior, not detection accuracy or independent validation.
Physical RTSP capture and field testing remain pending; the TCP-only probe was unreachable.
Mypy covers 14 API/development script files with check_untyped_defs; it is not strict typing of the entire project.
CI, Docker delivery, final documentation and the review PR belong to subsequent milestones.
development_failures_resolved: Initial integration fixtures referenced the wrong fictional model/reviewer UUIDs; corrected to match sample_data.json.
The first real-browser run used an immediate checkbox-state assertion; it now waits for the preference PATCH response and checks persisted state after reload.
